title: Settlement file upload failed
alert: SFTP authentication failed uploading the settlement file to SBI; merchant payouts delayed
root cause: SBI rotated its SFTP host key and our client rejected the new fingerprint
failed fixes: Retrying the upload repeatedly (locked the SFTP account)
fix: Bank ops unlocked the account, we added the new host fingerprint and re-uploaded the file

title: Users logged out repeatedly
alert: auth-service session not found errors; Redis evicted_keys climbing
root cause: Redis hit maxmemory and allkeys-lru evicted live sessions
fix: Raised Redis maxmemory, switched to volatile-lru and moved sessions to a dedicated Redis

title: OTP delivery dropped
alert: otp-service delivery_rate=62%, sms-gateway-a responding 429 Too Many Requests
root cause: A marketing push during month-end settlements used the same SMS route as OTPs and gateway A throttled us
failed fixes: Bulk-retrying failed OTPs (made the throttling worse)
fix: Failed over OTP traffic to sms-gateway-b and resumed the campaign in batches

title: Wallet top-ups failing
alert: Lock wait timeout exceeded on ledger_entries; wallet top-ups failing
root cause: The month-end reconciliation job ran on the primary database and locked ledger_entries
fix: Killed the reconciliation job and moved it to the read replica

title: Customers charged twice
alert: Duplicate debits reported; card 4539 8812 0093 2211, customer phone 9988776655
root cause: Checkout retried after a gateway timeout without an idempotency key, so the charge ran twice
failed fixes: Issuing manual refunds one by one
fix: Added an idempotency key on transaction id and auto-reversed the duplicate charges

root cause: Kotak was degraded on the payment switch and our retries doubled the load on it
